root_verification: Root read source Corollary 4.19, R_cyc(S_a, C_b^mon) = 1 + (a-1)(b-1) for b >= 2, and re-derived the bridge. Apply it at b-1 >= 3, so N = 1 + (a-1)(b-2) contains a colour-2 monotone C_{b-1} absent a colour-1 S_a. Each of the (a-2)(b-2) outside vertices w lies in a gap (c_i, c_{i+1}). A colour-2 edge from w to c_{i+1} gives the path w, c_{i+1}, ..., c_i; an edge to c_i gives the path c_{i+1}, ..., c_i, w. Otherwise w sends two colour-1 edges to the cycle. The cycle vertices have colour-1 degree <= a-2, so 2(a-2)(b-2) <= (b-1)(a-2), forcing b <= 3, a contradiction. The lower bound is source Theorem 4.5.
decision: EXCLUDED, zero credit: a one-paragraph bridge from the source's own Corollary 4.19 and Theorem 4.5 (precedents 369221, 374488, and the sibling 374246). The candidate's Lean endpoint is correct and faithful (root replay cycramsey-parent-check-r1 PASS), but it does not meet the substantive standard. A follow-up paper (arXiv:2607.06817v2) still lists 4.16 as conjectured; that does not change the ruling.
lesson: Before investing in a short proof, check every neighbouring result in the same source (the cycle version, other parameters, the ordered versus cyclic version) for a short extension argument.
